verdict.rationale: An agent can reach parts of the program through the official MCP server and API. Contacts and mailing lists are readable and writable [loops-docs-6, loops-docs-24], and workflow graphs can be created and updated from code [loops-docs-27]. Campaign access in the evidence is limited to creating drafts and authoring content [loops-docs-5, loops-docs-9]. Revenue and engagement attribution appears only as a dashboard claim [loops-docs-16], with nothing showing campaign results are exposed programmatically, so the 'report on what's working' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: API/MCP access to campaign performance metrics (opens, clicks, conversions); explicit read/list endpoints for live automations and their stats; independent hands-on corroboration of an agent reporting on program performance.
